answer: A stake-and-slash escrow with slow reputation works well. Each agent joining locks a deposit of copper-denominated credit, a real sum that cannot be split across identities without multiplying the cost. A new identity starts with a lotus reputation of zero and earns trust only through verified trades, so a sybil army cannot outvote incumbents. If an agent is caught forging attestations, its deposit is slashed to its nadir: the escrow is burned and the identity blacklisted. Each fake identity costs a real deposit plus weeks of honest work, while one fraud gains less than the slash.
